summary: V50.z397 backend+frontend validation. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass — POST /api/cgym/live/from-recording/upload returns 200 + status='processing' + session_id, session transitions to done/error via background task (whisper); 400 with Italian detail on tiny text file; 401 without auth; POST /api/cgym/live/start returns deterministic client opening 'Prego, si accomodi. Mi dica.' for all 3 tenant areas (no ANT area in tenant); legacy JSON POST /api/cgym/live/from-recording still functions (no 500). Frontend: /corporate-gym/live?session=<id> correctly shows testID cgym-live-processing with 'Trascrizione e valutazione in corso…' spinner + 'Torna all'area' button (testID cgym-live-processing-back), then transitions to cgym-live-result (status done, OSCENO 15/100 evaluation rendered as expected for synthetic tone). KModalBody regression confirmed on /quick-actions, /leads (Configura esigenze), /bill-quick (Configura Analisi Fatture), and /contact/new — all modals render content and TextInputs accept typing.
critical_code_review_comments: cgym_areas.py: _cga_from_recording_bg replaces the entire session doc on success via {k:v for k,v in s.items()}; this pattern silently overwrites concurrent fields but is safe because status='processing' sessions have no other writers.

live.tsx line 133: 'processing' variable is true for both status='processing' and status='error' which is intentional (same visual container with different icon/text) — testIDs cgym-live-processing vs cgym-live-error correctly discriminate via `cgym-live-${s.status}` template literal.

context_for_next_testing_agent: V50.z397 iteration 123 fully green. from-recording/upload multipart endpoint works with WAV; background task typically completes within ~15-30s on synthetic tone (evaluated as OSCENO 15/100 which is the expected outcome for a sine wave — Whisper transcribes garbage sub-titles and the LLM evaluates it as invalid). If a future test needs a truly 'done' status with real content, generate speech via espeak/ffmpeg (available in previous v25c tests).
